messages:
olivia: Quick postmortem follow-up. We need clear owners + deadlines for the testing work spawned by INC-2026-042: a regression prompt suite, a KV/load harness, a scoped chaos drill, and an eval gating alert. Can we assign owners here?
marco: I9ll take the KV/load harness + infra jobs. Plan: build a repeatable job that can run as a pipeline step or cron, include a perf dataset, and codify pass/fail thresholds. ETA ~10 business days. I9ll open a JIRA today.
jess: I can own the regression promptset and hooking it into nightly evals. Steps: convert failing user flows into prompts (aim ~150), add expected buckets, add to eval-harness and alerting. Target PR by 2026-03-25.
ryan: I9ll run the scoped chaos drill and update the drill playbook. Scope: routing + fallback mapping and the model-variant failover we hit. I9ll coordinate with oncall to reserve a window and run a dry-run first. Propose live drill 2026-04-06.
oncall-bot: Incident Bot: postmortem posted at https://redwood/example/postmortem/INC-2026-042. Temporary epic JIRA-4000 created.
triage-bot: Triage: created tasks JIRA-4001 (kv-load, owner=marco), JIRA-4002 (promptset/regression, owner=jess), JIRA-4003 (chaos-drill, owner=ryan).
marco: Infra details: spin up a small test cluster (3 nodes), run steady-state 50 rps then burst to 250 rps for 10m to reproduce evictions. I9ll add a job definition and a runbook snippet. Pass criteria: p95 latency < 250ms and error-rate < 0.5%.
jess: Promptset approach: extract the 10 failing paths from the incident traces, expand to paraphrases, target 150 prompts, add expected labels, and add gating rule on nightly: if score drops > 4% alert SRE + ML. Eval command I9ll use: 
`eval-harness --suite postmortem-2026 --model redwood/curated-v1 --report-to ops-alerts --threshold 0.87`
ryan: Drill playbook items I9ll add: pre-checks, rollback criteria, mapping table of model variants to fallbacks, post-drill smoke (basic end-to-end user flow), and a run-report template. Also schedule monthly recurrence.
olivia: Please add a one-line due date in your JIRA comments today. I9ll maintain a master checklist and schedule a cross-team sync next Tue. Also we need automation for the post-run report to be posted to #eng-oncall.
marco: JIRA-4001 updated with due date 2026-03-30 and a link to the perf dataset. Example run command I9m standardizing: 
`run-load --target kv-test-cluster --rps 250 --duration 10m --check p95<250ms --output /tmp/load-report.json`
jess: JIRA-4002 updated with due 2026-03-25 and PR link. I9ll add the gating rule to alert if regression score < 0.87 for two consecutive nightly runs.
ryan: JIRA-4003 updated with due 2026-04-06. Proposed drill window 2026-04-06 15:00-16:30 UTC. I9ll run a dry-run 2026-04-02 in the staging environment.
olivia: Two small asks: 1) add a smoke assertion that verifies fallback actually routes to the cheaper variant (we observed the hot path stayed on expensive variant during incident), 2) include an SLO check in the load job that fails the job if latency > threshold so we fail fast.
marco: will add the SLO check to the load job and include a JSON report.
jess: will add the fallback verification as part of the regression prompts where applicable and add a post-eval hook to assert routing decisions in the trace.
ryan: will add the fallback check to the drill smoke script and to the runbook. Also will add a post-drill retrospective template that links to the incident and JIRA tasks.
oncall-bot: Reminder: JIRA-4002 PR review reminder scheduled for 48h.
olivia: thanks everyone. I9ll post the master checklist and invite for the sync. Quick cron for nightly evals I9ll add once PRs are merged: 
`0 04 * * * /opt/redwood/evals/run_regression.sh --suite postmortem-2026 --report ops-alerts`
marco: noted. I9ll publish the load job YAML and a Jenkinsfile snippet after the PR.
jess: once promptset is in main I9ll wire it to the nightly pipeline and add the alert rule.
ryan: I9ll ping oncall once drill window is locked. :white_check_mark: 
olivia: moving this to done in the checklist when all JIRA tasks have PRs merged and cron entries exist. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:
